sections.Profile:
"Sea Belles" and "Fair Lady" are two-player electro-mechanical pinball machines released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1956. Both machines share identical playfield layouts but feature distinct themes and artwork. ​ "Sea Belles," released in August 1956, showcases a nautical theme. "Fair Lady," produced in November 1956, features a theatrical theme, highlighted by Janus masks on the backglass and an illuminated marquee on the flyer.
